title: EtherNet/IP & CIP active identification (no write/control)
description: Identify EtherNet/IP (44818) / CIP devices; read/identify only.
detail: Authorized, in-scope. **Active + read/identify allowed; NO WRITE/CONTROL.** 1) nmap --script enip-info -p 44818 for device identity/CIP info. 2) Read/identify only; no CIP writes, no parameter/firmware changes, no actuator commands. 3) Map Rockwell/Allen-Bradley & other CIP devices; record as facts.
